purpose: Evidence-backed application architecture snapshots for the 28 registered GitHub repositories. Repository code is inspected as source only; architecture descriptions do not imply that applications are deployed or healthy.

scan_method.source: GitHub recursive tree API plus selected README, dependency-manifest and application-entrypoint files
scan_method.snapshot_policy: Each record stores the exact source commit SHA used for the recursive tree scan; repos with empty trees have a null commit.

status_definitions.source-verified: Tracked application source and at least one implementation boundary/entrypoint were found.
status_definitions.source-limited: Some executable source exists, but key configuration/entrypoint evidence is missing or the product remains a scaffold.
status_definitions.documentation-only: The scanned default branch contains documentation but no runnable application implementation.

verification_limits: No app was started by this inventory scan.
No deployment URL or production health was inferred.
Integration names from dependencies or README may indicate declared/intentional integrations, not proven live connections.
Evidence paths are source references, not runtime guarantees.

layers.role: The API serves per-repository stack/layer/state/integration/evidence snapshots. The UI displays exact source commit/tree identity and path-only warnings for potentially sensitive tracked artifacts.

layers.name: State and audit
layers.role: SQLite stores source index and audit events; JSON files store canonical catalog/registry configuration.
layers.components: Local database at ~/.syscentre/syscentre.db and committed JSON metadata.

state_and_data: SQLite database at ~/.syscentre/syscentre.db stores the local source index and audit-event state; committed JSON files remain the catalog/registry source of truth.
The architecture register records commit SHA, Git tree SHA, commit date, inventory check date, evidence paths and limitations. It is a static snapshot, not a live source crawler.
Runtime adapter profiles remain unconfigured by default. Repository metadata and architecture snapshots do not imply that a project is runnable or healthy.
external_integrations: GitHub REST API is used for read-only repository metadata/tree/content ingestion; credentials, if supplied, remain runtime configuration and are not copied into the catalog.
No indexed repository's application code is executed by SysCentre.
limitations: This is a local-first control plane; the architecture explorer describes source snapshots rather than deployment/live health.
Architecture metadata is committed snapshot data and must be refreshed when a linked repository advances materially.
All project execution adapters remain unconfigured until a per-project target, command/action allowlist and real health check are verified.

policy: Document only observed files, manifests, and code boundaries. Keep planned modules distinct from implemented ones. Do not execute source code while indexing. Sensitive-looking repository findings expose paths and risk summaries only; never copy secret contents into SysCentre.
